sources.entry: PSequel - PostgreSQL GUI tool for Mac OS X. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: PSequel
summary.one_liner: PSequel is a PostgreSQL GUI client for macOS, written from scratch in Swift 2 with a UI inspired by Sequel Pro.
use_cases: Browsing and editing PostgreSQL data on a Mac
Using a lighter native alternative to pgAdmin
Managing PostgreSQL databases from a macOS desktop
Reporting bugs or requesting features for a Mac Postgres client
summary.what_it_does: The page is a FAQ for PSequel, a PostgreSQL client for macOS. The author says it is written from scratch in Swift 2 and its UI is highly inspired by Sequel Pro, not forked from it. The author describes the goal as implementing most Sequel Pro features, with priorities adjusted by user requests. Bugs and feature requests go to the GitHub issue tracker. The page does not list specific features beyond this.
notable: Written from scratch in Swift 2, not a fork of Sequel Pro
Not open source, per the FAQ
Built as a lighter alternative to pgAdmin
caveats: Not open source; no plan to open source it currently
Early stage; many Sequel Pro features are still planned
